note: Invented data for testing code behaviour only. Not real people, not real devices, not evidence of accuracy.

overnight-samples.csv.purpose: Individual timestamped overnight wrist-skin samples, 3 nights, 10-minute interval

vendor-nightly.json.purpose: One vendor-derived nightly value (not raw samples)

missing-timestamps-units.csv.purpose: Rows with a missing timestamp, a missing unit, an unrecognised unit and an invalid UTC offset, plus one valid row

mixed-units.csv.purpose: The same night reported partly in °C and partly in °F

overlap-conflict.csv.purpose: Re-upload overlap: one exact duplicate of overnight-samples.csv and one row with the same timestamp but a different value

device-tz-change.csv.purpose: Device replacement (new serial, model and firmware from 2026-01-09) and a time-zone change to UTC+09:00 from 2026-01-11

annotations-with-correction.csv.purpose: Bleeding entries with a later correction and a retraction; an illness flag

corrupted.csv.purpose: A broken file: an unterminated quote
